passage.text: Emma is planning her trip to Chiang Mai, but she can't decide between two hostels.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ɪz ˈplænɪŋ hɜːr ˈtrɪp tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ, bʌt ʃiː ˈkænt dɪˈsaɪd bɪˈtwiːn ˈtuː ˈhɑːstəlz.

passage.text: "Nam, can you help me?" she says.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈhɛlp miː? ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "The Green House is cheaper, but the River Hostel has a better location," Emma says.
passage.reading: ðə ˈɡriːn ˌhaʊs ɪz ˈtʃiːpər, bʌt ðə ˈrɪvər ˌhɑːstəl ˈhæz ə ˈbɛtər loʊˈkeɪʃən, ˈɛmə ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Nam reads the reviews on Emma's phone.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈriːdz ðə rɪˈvjuːz ɑːn ˈɛməz ˈfoʊn.

passage.text: "People say the River Hostel is cleaner and more comfortable," she says.
passage.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ðə ˈrɪvər ˌhɑːstəl ɪz ˈkliːnər ənd ˈmɔːr ˈkʌmftərbəl, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "And the reviews for the Green House say it's very noisy at night."
passage.reading: ənd ðə rɪˈvjuːz fər ðə ˈɡriːn ˌhaʊs ˈseɪ ɪts ˈvɛri ˈnɔɪzi ət ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: "Then I'll choose the River Hostel," Emma says.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈtʃuːz ðə ˈrɪvər ˌhɑːstəl, ˈɛmə ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "Great! And it's only ten minutes from the old city," Nam says.
passage.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ɪts ˈoʊnli ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts frəm ði ˈoʊld ˈsɪti, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.
